mapper.select: SELECT id FROM driver_safety_rating_control WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM driver_safety_rating_control WHERE id=1 FOR SHARE
SELECT b.* FROM driver_safety_rating_control c JOIN driver_safety_rating_batch b ON b.id=c.active_batch_id WHERE c.id=1
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM driver_safety_rating_batch WHERE week_key=#{week})
mapper.update: UPDATE driver_safety_rating_control SET active_batch_id=#{id} WHERE id=1
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM alert_archive_backfill WHERE id=1 AND last_id=through_id)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM alert_archive_outbox o LEFT JOIN alert_archive_batch b ON b.id=o.batch_id WHERE AND b.synced_at IS NULL)

SELECT u.id AS driver_id,u.create_time AS registered_at, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM transport_task t WHERE t.driver_id=u.id AND t.status='COMPLETED' AND t.ended_at BETWEEN u.create_time AND #{cutoff}) AS has_driving_history FROM sys_user u WHERE u.role='DRIVER' AND u.create_time<=#{cutoff} ORDER BY u.id
SELECT DISTINCT b.id,b.partition_date FROM alert_archive_outbox o JOIN alert_archive_batch b ON b.id=o.batch_id WHERE AND b.synced_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.partition_date,b.id
mapper.update: UPDATE driver_safety_rating_batch SET frozen_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT driver_id,registered_at,has_driving_history FROM driver_safety_rating_roster WHERE batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY driver_id
SELECT archive_id AS id,partition_date FROM driver_safety_rating_input WHERE batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY partition_date,archive_id
mapper.update: UPDATE driver_safety_rating_batch SET status='RUNNING' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE driver_safety_rating_batch SET stage1_application_id=COALESCE(#{one},stage1_application_id), stage2_application_id=COALESCE(#{two},stage2_application_id) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE driver_safety_rating_batch SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE driver_safety_rating_batch SET status='FAILED',error_message=#{message} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.driver_id,r.batch_id,r.score,r.level,b.data_as_of,b.published_at,r.has_driving_history FROM driver_safety_rating_control c JOIN driver_safety_rating_result r ON r.batch_id=c.published_batch_id JOIN driver_safety_rating_batch b ON b.id=r.batch_id WHERE c.id=1 AND b.status='PUBLISHED' AND r.driver_id IN #{id}
